document.about: Lutron Maestro LED+ dimmer submittal sheet. Its feature list sets each bullet at the margin and the item's text, wrapped lines and all, an em and a quarter in from it.

notes: A wrapped line starts right of the line it wraps from, and the bullet line is short of the column's edge, so the shift was read as a new paragraph: in DoCO each item lost its wrapped lines to a paragraph of their own. Markdown hid it, setting the paragraph on the line under the item, where a renderer joins the two.
